Class ReportRepository

java.lang.Object
edu.tamu.csce331.squad23.repository.ReportRepository
public class ReportRepository extends Object
Repository for accessing and generating various reports from the database. Provides methods to retrieve item sales, ingredient usage, and other report data within specified date ranges.

  • Method Details

    • findItemSales

      public List<ItemSalesRow> findItemSales(LocalDate start, LocalDate end) throws SQLException
      Totals the quantity sold and revenue for each item across all orders placed from start through end, both days inclusive. Revenue uses each line's saved unit price and does not include tips. Removed items are still counted, and orders of every status are included. Items with no sales in the range are left out. If start is after end, the result is empty.
      Parameters:
      start - first day of the range
      end - last day of the range
      Returns:
      one row per item, ordered by quantity sold (highest first), then by name
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the query fails.

      Parameters:

      end - last day of the range

      one row per ingredient, ordered by usage then name
      Throws:
